title: Implement hierarchical COBOL data scopes and exact layouts

acceptance_observations: Qualified identities replace global duplicate-name rejection; simple ambiguous names fail resolution while OF/IN and exact qualified paths select one layout.
Groups receive recursive extents and aggregate initial bytes; sibling REDEFINES and accepted same-name alternate definitions share offsets without advancing unrelated storage.
Levels 66, 77, 78, and 88, condition values, OCCURS ranges, OCCURS DEPENDING ON, indexes, 1-based subscripts, and reference modification are explicit bounded model state.
FILE, WORKING-STORAGE, LOCAL-STORAGE, and LINKAGE identities remain distinct while every extent stays within the program storage bound.
DISPLAY, signed overpunch, numeric-edited, big-endian binary, COMP-5, packed-decimal sign nibble, pointer, and group storage lengths/initial bytes are deterministic.

The exact length-delimited layout digest covers program path, qualified identity, level, section, offsets, lengths, category, initial bytes, aliases, occurrences, and dependency names for all 44 closures.
